cross_checked_findings.finding: perception_control.evaluate_head resolves dependencies from a central DAG; unknown, COMPUTE_OFF or taint-blocked heads return NOT_COMPUTED with value=null before compute_fn executes.

The archived Phase-43 ablation reports object.known.cup COMPUTE_OFF -> NOT_COMPUTED while person.presence remained OK on the same real frame. This is bounded component evidence only and was not rerun in this ingest.

Realtime function calls are queued until response.done; a non-completed response or barge-in clears queued calls before local tool dispatch, preventing execution of tool requests from a cancelled conversational turn.

VoiceSessionCapsule is an ephemeral projection refreshed from several live sources; its useful role is a bounded compiled view, not a second state authority. Cross-source transactional consistency is not established by the inspected donor spans.

world_substrate_epistemic_gate.law: NOT_COMPUTED is first-class and distinct from false, zero, UNKNOWN and negative evidence.
world_substrate_epistemic_gate.dependency_rule: A protected variable/head disabled at COMPUTE_OFF or taint-blocked by a disabled dependency must remain NOT_COMPUTED through WorldNeed/WorldSlice expansion; inverse/decomposition logic may not silently reconstruct it as if measured.
world_substrate_epistemic_gate.control_surface: Reuse a central dependency graph plus one enforcement adapter rather than caller-supplied dependency declarations.
acceptance: Disable one protected upstream WorldSlice variable and prove downstream dependent variables remain NOT_COMPUTED.
Prove an unrelated control variable still computes in the same cycle.
Prove no persisted vector/projection for the protected dimension is emitted when computation is disabled.

pending_effect_cancellation.law: Cancellation before deterministic effect admission/dispatch must invalidate the pending candidate; cancellation after external submission must not be rewritten as definitely cancelled and may require outcome UNKNOWN.
acceptance: Barge-in after function-call emission but before dispatch produces CANCELLED_PRE_DISPATCH and zero effect execution.
Non-completed model response cannot dispatch queued tool calls.
Cancellation after a mocked external submission cannot mint CANCELLED_PRE_DISPATCH; retain OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until verified.

voice_context_snapshot.law: Voice context remains a noncanonical compiled projection over canonical/current sources.
voice_context_snapshot.freshness_rule: If decision-relevant privacy/policy/generation changed after compilation, refresh or downgrade/withhold the affected field rather than presenting stale state as current.
voice_context_snapshot.minimality_rule: Compile only the bounded fields causally needed for the current response; do not dump UnifiedDB or the full capsule into prompts.

dedupe_note: Effect admission, VERIFIED-overload and session-level effect-pointer findings are not credited again here because dedicated effect-path/effect-authority deltas already exist and canonical-main has a Triggerword-5 -> Triggerword-4 effect-contract handoff.

preserved_open_contradictions.question: Whether the separately referenced historical/global wache-koenig path is present, ordered and authoritative in the actual host runtime remains artifact-unproven for the pinned donor.
The central evaluate_head gate is strong where used, but repository-wide reachability must still prove no live privacy-sensitive compute path bypasses it.
Capsule refresh reads multiple live sources without an established atomic cross-source snapshot; stronger autonomous use needs explicit provenance/freshness semantics.
